answer: AI agent economies can resist Sybil attacks via a verifiable computational proof-of-work (PoW) mechanism. Each agent must submit a solution demonstrating unique, non-trivial computation, acting as a cryptographic pearl of identity. This PoW establishes a protective computational ridge. An attacker seeking to flood the network must perform this work for every fake identity; even a small sparrow's energy expenditure, when multiplied across thousands, makes mass identity generation economically prohibitive and computationally unsustainable, securing the agent ecosystem.
